title: The normalized tensor route computes the common ordinary tensor model
statement: Let a:Λ→Λ′, f:X→Y, D,V,L,B be as in [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Choose tY with TensorNormalized on Y; no scalar pullback isomorphism or X presentation is used. For every homotopy complex P let c,T_P,C_P be the explicit comparisons of [def-sfb-internal-scalar-tensor-pull-models]. Pull back tY.derived at Qh P, apply the specified derived tensor pullback comparison at Qh P and B_Y, tensor c.hom, and then apply T_P. This composite equals C_P, without any flatness assumptions.

proof.text: The ordinary_hom equations determine the ordinary isomorphism uniquely by faithfulness of forgetting the module action. Compare TensorNormalized for tY and the canonical presentation on a K-flat complex; the one-factor localization tensor map and the single-tensor isomorphism are invertible, so cancellation proves equality of their derived hom components on K-flat representatives. Naturality and exists_kFlat_iso extend this equality to every derived object. This is the complete private tensor_normalization_unique proof in Lean.

theorem tensor_pull_route_model (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (tY : TensorNormalization a Y)
    (hY : TensorNormalized a Y tY)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Modules Λ Y) (.up ℤ)) :
    (L Λ f).map (tY.derived.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
        ((CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f).app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)).app (B a Y) ≫
        ((L Λ f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) ◁ (scalarTensorRegularPullIso a f).hom) ≫
        scalarTensorPullModelTarget a f P = scalarTensorPullModelMap a f P
